name: firecracker
description_en: Secure and fast microVMs for serverless computing.
readme_excerpt: Our mission is to enable secure, multi-tenant, minimal-overhead execution of container and function workloads. Read more about the Firecracker Charter here. What is Firecracker? Firecracker is an open source virtualization technology that is purpose-built for creating and managing secure, multi-tenant container and function-based services that provide serverless operational models.
